observations: Photo 0: a split air conditioner, white wall-mounted indoor unit resting on top of its outdoor condenser unit, on a tiled floor by a wooden door.
Photo 0: outdoor unit front reads a faded red 'SANYO' logo with 'inverter' printed under it.
Photo 0: indoor unit carries small 'SANYO' text at its top right and rating stickers on the louvre area that are too small to read, so the capacity is not readable.
Photo 0: indoor unit is yellowed and dirty, louvre flap hanging open; outdoor unit has dirt and scuffs, fan grille intact.
Photo 0: a short cable end hangs from the side of the outdoor unit; no copper connecting pipes, remote control or wall bracket shown.
Photo 0: outdoor unit size looks like a small household unit, roughly in the 1 to 1.5 horsepower range.

identity.kind: split inverter air conditioner, indoor and outdoor unit (faulty)
read_from: photo 0 outdoor unit front: SANYO inverter
photo 0 indoor unit top right: SANYO

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'inverter' printed on the outdoor unit under the Sanyo logo.
Seller admits a fault but does not say what it is; the fault itself is not visible. It is accepted for pricing because it can only lower the price.

risks.risk: Capacity unknown; a smaller unit is worth less as parts or scrap
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the rating plate on the side of the outdoor unit showing model and capacity
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest household size, 1 horsepower

risks.risk: Compressor, PCB boards or fan motors may be dead or already removed
risks.proof: Photo with the outdoor unit side panel off showing the compressor and inverter board in place
risks.if_unproven: as scrap metal value with no working parts

risks.risk: Remote, connecting copper pipes and wall bracket missing
risks.proof: Photo of the remote, pipes and bracket laid next to the units
risks.if_unproven: as without remote, pipes or bracket

proof_requests: Sharp photo of the outdoor unit rating plate showing model and capacity
Photo with the outdoor side panel removed showing the compressor and inverter board
Short description or clip of the fault, for example powering on and showing the error code
Photo of any remote, copper pipes and bracket included
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a Sanyo split inverter AC set and the seller admits it is faulty, so it can be priced at its worst case as a faulty unit for parts at the smallest household capacity. A readable rating plate and a photo showing the compressor in place would raise it.
